[P3] Revisit the untested probe rejection guards

Rule 4, “Every branch has a test that fails without it,” remains unmet here and in case 23's identical guard. All scenarios supply an active SDK span, including the no-ambient cases; case 23's negative tests change the helper outcome, not the tracing context. Removing either rejection leaves the assertions unchanged. Return to the design phase under rule 8 and establish whether these guards add a necessary contract beyond the existing parentage assertions, then choose the smallest demonstrably tested approach.
